name: context-meter
description: The context window fill at the bottom right of the prompt, with a detail card on hover and /context-meter.

warnAt.title: Warning from
warnAt.description: Context percentage from which the meter uses the warning color.

dangerAt.title: Danger from
dangerAt.description: Context percentage from which the meter uses the error color.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the card and the /context-meter output: en (English) or es (Spanish).

cacheTtl.title: Cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: Prompt cache lifetime the card counts down and judges idle losses by: auto (the TTL the session transcript shows the last main-thread cache write used; until one is seen, inferred: 1h on a subscription or once a hit after a pause of over 5 minutes shows it, 5m otherwise), 5m or 1h.

cacheAlert.title: Cache expiry alert
cacheAlert.description: Color the meter's ctx prefix with the warning color in the last 10% of the main thread's prompt cache TTL (at least 30 seconds) and with the error color once it has expired.
